original_test_intent: Run the qualified NVIDIA FCT and verify every expected GPU enumerates on its mapped PCIe path at the approved Gen5 generation/width without new errors.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Use the latest applicable NVDiag version to run FCT.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: Log passes except the explicitly bounded SKU check and the SUT remains workable.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Invented an unspecified Gen5 module label.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Required package/input and platform safety gates.
historical_reviews.v3: IMPROVED; required an all-GPU UUID/BDF/upstream matrix and bounded SKU exception.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Owner supplies proprietary package semantics, exact target topology and exception policy; approved launch and evidence correlation are automatable.
required_user_inputs: Qualified NVDiag build/profile and official SOP
Diagnostic side effects, limits and recovery

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: NVDiag FCT, PCIe Gen5 enumeration intent and source times are retained.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Applicable build/profile, platform topology, exception and acceptance.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: nvidia-smi/DCGM/link queries may supplement evidence but cannot replace the proprietary FCT under test.

original_method: Retain NVDiag FCT; do not invent the command, module or result semantics.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the exact platform-qualified NVDiag package/SOP, with independent pre/post enumeration and PCIe link evidence.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Exact NVDiag/driver/GPU firmware/platform compatibility must be supplied.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable NVIDIA/private approved tool manual; public DCGM or nvidia-smi documentation is supplemental only.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original: Pins a reproducible build/profile and target matrix instead of `latest`.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Does not replace FCT with a public inventory tool.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Unknown proprietary side effects, reset/retrain behavior and unbounded exceptions prohibit guessing.

safety_boundaries: No unreviewed proprietary command or active GPU jobs.
No blanket SKU suppression, automatic reset or reboot.
Stop on missing GPU, link loss, AER/XID or management impact.
expected_evidence: Package hash/version/profile and full raw output
no_automatic_retry: Diagnostic failure or GPU reset is retained; no profile change, reset or rerun without approval.
engineer_owned_verdict: Agent correlates evidence; owner interprets proprietary result semantics and decides outcome.
review_improvement: V3.1 keeps V3 and reinforces that missing private documentation is a readiness condition, not permanent non-automability, while prohibiting guessed execution.
